roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for staff, alongside managing and overseeing all infection control initiatives. Your expertise will contribute significantly to maintaining a healthy and compliant environment, supported by a competitive hourly rate.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development, education, or training within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations pertaining to skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a highly confidential search for a leader who can drive market presence and community engagement for a recently acquired center. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping the facility's reputation and growth.This position requires a professional who is not only presentable but also possesses a proactive and results-oriented mindset. You will be instrumental in developing and executing marketing strategies, with an emphasis on community outreach and building strong referral networks. The role involves occasional weekend work and offers competitive compensation for the right individual who is ready to make a significant impact.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
Demonstrated proactive and results-driven approach to market development and community relations
Strong communication, interpersonal, and networking abilities

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP). This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, along with a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus. We are seeking a dedicated professional to provide essential speech and language services to our residents on an as-needed basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for an SLP looking for flexibility and the chance to make a significant impact within a supportive environment. If you are passionate about patient care and meet the qualifications, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current Florida state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00 with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a PRN Physical Therapist. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to provide essential therapy services on an as-needed basis, offering flexibility and the chance to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.In this role, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and implementing individualized treatment programs for patients, helping them regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. We are seeking a compassionate and highly motivated individual committed to delivering exceptional patient care.This PRN position offers the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life while contributing to a supportive and dynamic healthcare environment. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and eager to work with a diverse patient population, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist (PT)
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL, as a valued Rehabilitation Therapy Professional. We are actively seeking dedicated Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA), Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA), Occupational Therapists (OT), and Speech Therapists (ST) to enhance our patient care team. This is an excellent opportunity for both full-time and part-time professionals looking to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents.

You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing individualized therapy plans, helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. We offer a supportive environment where your expertise is valued, and professional growth is encouraged. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and committed to delivering exceptional care, we invite you to explore this rewarding position.

We offer competitive hourly rates, with specific compensation based on your role and experience. This is a chance to join a dynamic team dedicated to clinical excellence and patient-centered care in a vibrant community.
requirements: Active and unrestricted COTA, PTA, OT, or ST license/certification in the state of Florida.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation center is preferred.
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Strong commitment to patient-centered care and clinical excellence.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA) and Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) can expect $28.00 - $37.00/hr for full-time positions. Physical Therapists (PT), Occupational Therapists (OT), and Speech Therapists (ST) can expect $40.00 - $46.00/hr for full-time and part-time positions.
